summary: Executed backend pytest regression and frontend desktop/mobile E2E validation on the public preview URL for all requested service-detail and integration flows.
action_items: No blocking defects found in requested scope.
Optional hardening: use deterministic chat action data-testid values (in addition to dynamic IDs) to reduce E2E selector ambiguity.
critical_code_review_comments: Service and chatbot flows pass, but chat action testability is brittle because action button testids are timestamp-derived (multiple same-label buttons can coexist in history).

success_rate.frontend: 97% (requested functional flows passed; one non-product automation instability observed in repeated chatbot matrix attempts due selector ambiguity)

test_credentials: No auth flows in scope. /app/memory/test_credentials.md is present but empty.
seed_data_creation: No dedicated seed data created. TEST_ prefixed contact submissions were used and cleaned by existing pytest fixtures.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Validated exact homepage service order and service-card links; all 8 direct /services/:slug routes with matching H1 and required section counts (4 deliverables, 4 process steps, ideal-for list, 3 outcomes, next-service link, final CTA); next capability cycle 08->01; service nav logo/home + All Services/home; Start a Project hero/final CTA prefill to contact; chatbot paid-leads recommendation routing; contact API UI submission success; mobile menu and mobile overflow/clipping checks passed. Earlier image-load failures were timing-related and passed with explicit image-load waits.
rca of the issue: No confirmed product defects found in this run. Observed instability was test-side: chatbot matrix retries became ambiguous when multiple historical 'View service details' actions remained in chat history; selecting by newest action or resetting chat is required for deterministic automation.
